newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr Lyonnais says Bergamasco talks go on.
newsitem.headline: Cr Lyonnais says Bergamasco talks go on.

text.p: A spokeswoman for French state bank Credit Lyonnais, which plans to sell its 56.8 percent stake in Italy's Credito Bergamasco, said on Thursday talks were still going on at the moment on the issue and that the French bank had no further comment.

Credito Bergamasco, based in northern Italy, was suspended from the Milan bourse for the day on Thursday pending release of a statement on the bank's future, Italian stock market watchdog Consob said.
Bank sources said earlier this week Credit Lyonnais was expected to sign a deal to sell the stake to Banca Populare di Verona.

The French bank is refocusing its activities under pressure to sell assets in return for European Commission approval of state aid payments to the bank. It has said it plans to keep a presence in Italy in the corporate finance domain.
Italian bank San Paolo de Brescia said on June 3 it was interested in buying Credito Bergamasco, which specialises in retail banking and small and medium sized companies.
